The rate limiter is `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`. It exports `consumeRateLimit`, `RATE_LIMIT_BUCKETS`, `getBucketConfig`, `setOrgPlan` and `resetRateLimits`. Nine source files import `consumeRateLimit` from `@/lib/rate-limit`, and one test file imports from it directly.

Four test files (`tests/server/plan-limits.test.ts`, `tests/services/search-service.test.ts`, `tests/services/comment-service.test.ts`, `tests/services/invitation-service.test.ts`) reference the module only as a `vi.mock("@/lib/rate-limit", …)` target. They import from a test double instead, so I left them out. `tests/lib/errors.test.ts` and `src/lib/errors.ts` only use the string `rate_limited`. The `rate_limit_buckets` table in `src/server/db/schema/webhooks.ts` and `src/server/db/migrate.ts` is persisted state, not an import.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/auth-service.ts, src/actions/auth/login.ts, src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts, src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts, src/actions/members/invite-member.ts, tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts
